text: raschke: "Higher low re-entered on heavy volume ... C2 retracement buy". A retracement buy needs a trend to retrace inside. My stage test (C2, C3) finds none: 50-day under the 200-day and rs_rank_pct 54.2 under 70 (criteria 4, 8), and seow adds ret_63d -3.5. A higher low in a stack that is not rising is a stage 1 base; buying it is anticipation. day_vol 2.03 is real effort; it does not supply the trend. What clears me: ma50 over ma200 with rs_rank_pct over 70, then a pivot cleared on volume.
